# Open questions for the golden vectors

The recommended answers below are now in `docs/spec.md` §9 (Kash didn't object, 27 Oct). The vectors use them and list them in their `assumes` field. If Kash picks a different answer, change the vectors that list it.

| # | Question | Recommended answer (used by the vectors) | Why | Vectors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 | What happens when several things fall on the same millisecond, and are window edges inclusive? | Engine first (counter close, hits landing, beat draw, timeout), then that ms's inputs. Counter window `[resolve, resolve+700)`. A vote at `2400·(N+1)` belongs to beat N+1. A beat whose hit would land at or after 75,000 isn't drawn (30 attacks per round). | §2 says the defence is "decided on the input state when the hit lands", so an input in the same ms is too late. Half-open windows make 699/700 clean. Drawing an attack that can't land would show a telegraph that never resolves. | `dmg-counter-window-edges`, `vote-window-boundary`, `round-thirty-attacks`, `edge-guard-at-landing-ms`, `edge-ko-same-ms`, `edge-input-at-round-end` |
| Q2 | Is the 450 ms punch throttle measured from the last counted punch or the last attempt, and does it reset when a counter window opens? | From the last counted punch; ignored punches don't restart it; it ignores window boundaries. A punch at exactly +450 counts. | Measuring from attempts would let a flailing player lock themselves out. The spike throttles the punch detector, not the window. | `dmg-two-punches-in-window`, `dmg-throttle-450`, `dmg-throttle-carries-into-window` |
| Q3 | Is "below 30" checked before or after the hit, per COMBO hit, and is damage rounded? | Strictly `hp < 30` before each hit (each COMBO hit checked on its own); no rounding (HP is a float, shown rounded in the UI). | "Below 30" excludes 30. Rounding would make the ×0.6 invisible on CHIP 3 (1.8). | `dmg-mercy-boundary-30`, `dmg-mercy-hit-and-chip`, `round-ko-mid-combo` |
| Q4 | Within a beat draw, does hype gain apply before or after a SUPER resets it? Is a `!super` sent at hype 99.9 re-counted when hype hits 100? | Order: pick the move, add the beat's hype gain, then a SUPER sets hype to 0 (so hype is 0 right after a SUPER). The SUPER gate is checked when the vote arrives; a dropped vote stays dropped. | Hype only changes at beat ends, so checking at arrival matches "only count while hype = 100" and keeps the tally the viewer sees honest. | `vote-super-gate-and-spend` |
| Q5 | Does the counter damage from a BLOCK/PERFECT/DODGE count for a KO? | Yes: counters apply at the landing and can KO at that ms. | Nothing in the spec says otherwise, and it is the most satisfying KO. | `round-ko-by-counter-at-zero` |
| Q6 | For the fix rule (last 8 leans, ≤ 62.5%): which leans count, what is "dominant", and when can a card come back? | The last 8 **dodge** leans (the same log as the card). "Dominant" = the card's side. Checked after each new dodge. After a fix, a new card is judged only on dodges logged after the fix (n ≥ 12 again). | Using the card's side avoids a flip-flop where 5R/3L "fixes" a left card as a right habit. Restarting the count stops the card reappearing on the very next dodge. | `scout-fix-at-62-5` |
| Q7 | `!veto` freezes the game (§7 test 14) and cancels the telegraph. What happens to the clock and the next beat on `!resume`? | Vectors only assert up to the freeze: cancelled attack, `paused = true`, no damage, no counter, inputs ignored while frozen. Recommended: freeze the round clock and beat timer and continue from where they stopped on `!resume`; the vetoed beat counts as drawn (it stays in `history`). | The spec doesn't say whether time keeps running while frozen, so no vector tests resume. | `edge-veto-mod-jab`, `edge-veto-no-counter` |
| Q8 | Across rounds of a match: does the RNG continue, does `history` (no-triple) reset, and does the exploit cooldown reset? | One RNG per round seeded from the match seed + round number; `history` and the cooldown reset with the round; the scouting log carries over (spec). | Each round is then reproducible on its own, which is how these vectors run. | none yet (all vectors are single rounds) |
| Q9 | A COMBO's `landsAt` is the first hit, but when are its counter and window applied? | At the second hit (`L+300`), once both hits are known: the window is `[L+300, L+1000)`. | A counter at the first hit would have to be taken back if hit 2 lands, and the spec says "no counter if either hit lands". | `def-combo-row`, `def-combo-split` |
